SELECT
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM source_events
        WHERE status = 'received'
    ) AS pending_events,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM source_events
        WHERE status = 'processing'
    ) AS processing_events,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM source_events
        WHERE status = 'ready'
          AND customer_id IS NULL
    ) AS unresolved_customers,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM source_events
        WHERE status = 'manual_review'
    ) AS identity_reviews,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM source_events
        WHERE status = 'failed'
          AND next_retry_at IS NULL
    ) AS exhausted_event_failures,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM hubspot_sync_jobs
        WHERE status IN ('pending', 'processing')
    ) AS pending_hubspot_jobs,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM hubspot_sync_jobs
        WHERE status = 'failed'
          AND next_retry_at IS NULL
    ) AS exhausted_hubspot_failures,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM contact_change_proposals
        WHERE status IN ('pending', 'conflict')
    ) AS change_reviews,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM source_events
        WHERE status = 'received'
          AND received_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'
    ) AS stale_received_events;

INSERT INTO system_health_snapshots (
    health_status,
    metrics,
    alerts
)
VALUES (
    $1,
    $2::jsonb,
    $3::jsonb
)
RETURNING id, checked_at;
